scrapeNotes: Small catalog — every whole-bean/cold-brew product was sold out at scrape time. Site also sells the same coffees as 'Hot Brew Bags' / 'Cold Brew Bags' format under separate product URLs (e.g. /products/original-hot-brew-bags-copy) and non-coffee items (matcha, brewing equipment) — those format/equipment variants were not scraped in detail here, only the 6 core coffee products.

coffees.name: Sunrise Blend | 80% Arabica 20% Robusta
coffees.tastingNotes: Good body, balanced bitterness, slight acidity, extra caffeine kick from Robusta. Roasted in small batches.

coffees.name: Vienna Roast | 100% Arabica
coffees.tastingNotes: Intense bitterness, bold flavor, best enjoyed with milk; full-bodied, subtle sweetness in aroma.

coffees.name: Original Blend | 100% Arabica
coffees.tastingNotes: Sweet and inviting aroma, almost caramel with subtle fruity hint; smooth, balanced, comforting. Versatile for beginners or enthusiasts.

coffees.name: Classic Cold Brew
coffees.tastingNotes: Bold, intense, smooth, rich; nutty and chocolatey notes, mild spice, perfectly bitter without sourness.

variants.label: Pack of 6 x 200ml bottles (price not shown, sold out)

coffees.name: Whiskey Fermented Cold Brew
coffees.process: Fermented in whiskey barrels — green beans alternated between retired whiskey barrels and African drying beds
coffees.tastingNotes: Smooth, velvety texture with whiskey essence; recommended over ice.

coffees.name: Monsoon Malabar AA | 100% Arabica
coffees.process: Monsooning — green coffees exposed to humid coastal winds
coffees.tastingNotes: Bold, mellow acidity, spicy and earthy notes.
